contract.hardware: Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 / Radeon 890M / 32GiB / Windows11 build26300
contract.input_class: Three generated independent original H264 3840x2160 60/1 sources with repeated source offsets
contract.cache_state: Fresh frozen application each trial; repeated offsets; unmanaged OS cache
contract.observer: Native counter delta / unchanged wall time incl endpoint tail; actual175% DPI,356x200 physical; no fake focus; verified foreground/uncovered; default PDH observer with cost telemetry; job-owned hidden launch and OS-known-folder environment. Not physical scanout.

collection: Final console-corrected05bcdbd MSI. Every attempt retained, including confirmed pre-playback observer ReferenceError failures; additional numbered cases complete measured workload. No genuine application/playback failure or poor FPS score is automatically replaced.

throughput_windows.method: Native status-counter deltas over >=window, <=window+.5 s; not physical scanout.
Native status-counter deltas over >=window, <=window+.5 s; not physical scanout.

window_condition.scope: Physical center hit-test and window state, not physical scanout. Owned QA topmost/cover windows only; no global Windows settings.
window_condition.selection_scope: Every detected condition violation and first/last samples retained; full generated raw trace remains local. Scores and failed attempts are never excluded.

physical_alignment.scope: Default browser zoom; physical HWND/client coordinates, independent of the reported emulated DPR.

active_throughput_windows.method: Native status-counter deltas over >=window, <=window+.5 s; not physical scanout. Frame-zero preparation and terminal paused status excluded.

all_metric_attempts.scope: All numeric measured attempts, including failed audio/focus/application checks; incomplete attempts without FPS are not assigned an invented score.

metric_scope: Completed measured trials summarized; all failures and partial/no-metric attempts remain in rows and failed_trials.
variance_scope: Across-run variation and histogram upper bounds; exact per-frame variance and physical scanout are not measured.
ordering_scope: Original numbered attempts retained. Only proven observer ReferenceError before playback received new numbered attempts; ten workload attempts per arm, not ten selected passing scores. Every numeric failed workload is included in descriptive metrics. Ordinal table rows are not simultaneous paired measurements; failed focus/audio attempts do not establish controlled performance acceptance.
